---
title: "Before the session"
---

Before the session, read the background page and open the slides once on the machine that you will bring. There is nothing to install and nothing to register for.

## 1. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the claim on which the session works and the five reanalyses of it in the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026).

## 2. The slides {#the-deck}

[Open the slides](../../live/short.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the webR workspace at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Open the slides the evening before the session, on the machine and in the browser that you will bring, wait until the cell on their second slide shows a "Run Code" button, and run it. It should report 270 rows, 27 countries and 10 years, and your browser then keeps the files that the slides downloaded. If the slides do not load, try another browser; the webR workspace holds the same tasks outside the slides, as the fallback.
